card.name: Digits and spaces before section numbers
card.fires_on: Short pieces right before a number in label cross-references and schedules, such as the 2 in '( 2.2 )', the space before '8.1' or 'day 1', and a hyphen inside 'SN-38'. It also fires on the hyphen in 'flat-topped'.

modes.label: Cross-reference numbers
modes.description: The first digit or the space before a section number inside parentheses in highlights text.

modes.label: Space before a count
modes.description: A space just before a day or week number in a dosing schedule.
modes.example: starting on day<< >>1 of a 21-day course

modes.label: Hyphen in compounds
modes.description: A hyphen inside a compound that continues into a following word or number.
modes.example: flat<<-t>>opped, itchy pink or purple raised

card.writes: It promotes 'top' variants, which fits the 'flat-topped' case, but this effect is not clear for the number cases.
